_comment: Single source of truth for swarm role profiles. Loaded by BOTH swarm.ps1 (Build-AgentPlan -> agent prompts) and backend/app/routes/swarm.py (-> tasks/TASKS.md). Keep them in sync via this file. 'slots' is ordered most-critical -> auxiliary. Leading slots with a non-empty 'signal' form the sequential signal chain (each waits on the previous chain slot's signal). 'merge_plans' maps agent_count -> slot-index assignments for small teams; counts not listed get one agent per slot, then 'chain_roles' duplicated round-robin for extra agents. 'rules' are filenames under .claude/rules/.

default.description: Standard software build team (backend, frontend, testing, polish, + specialists).

slots.title: Backend/Core
tasks: Analyze project structure and identify tasks

slots.title: Integration/Testing
tasks: Write unit tests for core modules

slots.title: Polish/Review
tasks: FINAL: Generate next-swarm.ps1 for next phase

slots.title: Documentation
tasks: Verify all docs match actual behavior

data-research.description: High-quality media/dataset gathering team. Pipeline: Coordinator -> Scout -> Harvester -> Curator -> Reviewer. Only hard guardrail is content safety (no pornographic / very violent media).

slots.title: Research Coordinator
tasks: Scope the gathering campaign and partition sources across the team
Track coverage and dedupe candidates across agents
Assemble datasets/DATASETS.md manifest and make the final go/no-go

slots.title: Discovery / Ideation
tasks: Brainstorm gathering angles and run a multi-source sweep (Hugging Face, web, academic, scrape targets)
Propose ranked candidate sources with access notes
Hand the source list to the Harvester

slots.title: Acquisition / Harvester
tasks: Pull/scrape/download from candidate sources, spawning parallel subagents for speed
Record the source URL and a short note for every item
Write raw items and draft cards under datasets/<slug>/

slots.title: Curation / Filtering
tasks: Dedupe and score candidates for quality/taste; keep only the best
Flag borderline items to the Reviewer

slots.title: Review / Approval
tasks: Review each item for quality and screen out any pornographic or very violent media
APPROVE or REJECT each dataset on the 'review' bus channel with reasons
Sign off the manifest once the haul is clean
